raw_definitions: Definisi : vi mengebu: the crowd ~ed when the striker missed the goal, penonton-penonton mengebu apabila pemain penyerang gagal menjaringkan gol; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n sorak bu: the singer was greeted by ~s and hoots, penyanyi itu disambut dgn sorak bu dan ejekan; /will, would, could/ not say ‘~’ to a goose, ( colloq ) penakut; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
